title: Server-absolute imports under js/ make 19 modules un-requireable from the CJS tests
description: 19 modules under js/ import by server-absolute path (from '/js/utils/dom.js'). It resolves in the renderer because the app serves the repo root, and Node cannot resolve it at all - it fails with ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND, Cannot find module at a drive-root path, so ANY module graph reaching one of these files is un-requireable from the CJS suite. Found 2026-09-21 on MPI-877: importing js/shell/navigation.js from js/shell/agentDispatch.js pulled navigation -> MpiAudioRecorder -> MpiLevelMeter and broke tests/agent-pinned-settings.test.cjs, which has nothing to do with audio. MPI-877 routed around it (new import-free js/shell/activeMask.js) rather than fixing it. Fix: relative paths, matching every other module in each folder, plus an ESLint guard so it cannot come back.
